app.title: TurboKV: Insanely fast Rust key-value store
app.author: rgbimbochamp
app.description: A high-performance Rust-based key-value store optimized for speed and low latency.
proposed_tests: Build the project using Cargo and run unit tests
Initialize a database instance and perform 1,000 put/get operations while measuring throughput
Execute a batch write of 10,000 keys and compare write latency against RocksDB
Run a concurrent read/write workload with 10 threads and verify data consistency
